authorship_disclosure: The V31 aggregate and annual Stage-B outcomes were already visible when this chart protocol was frozen. The chart window, outcome buckets, 5x5 sheet layout and signal-time taxonomy inherit the earlier V30 protocol; the V31-specific changes correct calendar-coordinate identity and prevent future-dependent visual scaling.
purpose: Render every one of the 1,602 immutable V31 development events and enforce a two-pass review in which signal-time morphology is frozen before outcome-group attribution is opened.

calendar_coordinate_contract.stage_a_local_index: Stage-A candidate signal_cal_idx is local to the CY-006 2018-start input and may not define the chart window.
calendar_coordinate_contract.chart_index: Use prepared_candidates.signal_cal_idx, which is the accepted global coordinate-state cal_idx and must equal outcomes.signal_cal_idx.
calendar_coordinate_contract.missing_slots: Retain the global calendar slot as blank; no forward fill, backfill, or current-survivor substitution.

chart_contract.contact_sheet_layout: 5 by 5; at most 25 charts per page
complete_coverages: Every event appears exactly once in the full individual-chart index.
Every event appears exactly once in the masked chronological collection.
Every event appears exactly once in the mutually exclusive outcome-group collection.
scale_isolation: Blue price scale is computed only from valid relative_session<=0 OHLC.
Blue turnover scale is computed only from relative_session<=0 turnover.
Orange OHLC, turnover, entry, target, exit, status and return cannot affect any blue plot pixel.
The masked chronological chart reveals no post-signal candle or outcome label.
marks_in_full_attribution_chart: frozen +10 percent target beginning at entry
exact lifecycle status and mutually exclusive outcome bucket
chart_contract.publication: Build in a unique same-parent staging directory, rehash every bound input before publication, audit all files and exactly-once coverages, atomically rename, refuse overwrite, and delete only runner-owned staging on failure.

NO_COMPLETED_TRADE.definition: no completed lifecycle under the frozen Stage-B contract

phase_1: Review all 65 chronological pages at original resolution with post-signal panels and all outcome labels masked.
Assign signal-time morphology or NONE_CLEAR to every occupied cell.
Freeze and hash the complete 1,602-row chronology ledger before phase 2.
phase_2: Only after phase-1 freeze, review all 66 outcome-group pages at original resolution.
Append attribution, group observations and counterexamples; do not rewrite phase-1 morphology.
post_signal_used_as_predictor must remain false for every event.

future_rule_policy: Stage C creates and reviews charts only. If review evidence warrants zero to five deterministic signal-time rules, a separate Stage-D rule-compression contract must be frozen before any rule-level outcome aggregation.

development_gate_state.later_period: 2021 and 2022-2024 remain closed regardless of Stage-C visual observations.

prohibited: using any post-signal candle, entry, target, exit, status, return, panel scale, date, symbol or industry as a signal-time rule
opening outcome-group pages before the complete chronology ledger is frozen and hashed
skipping, sampling, deleting, duplicating or reselecting events
rule aggregation, strategy replay, market-state filtering or parameter search in Stage C
opening 2021 or later rows or outcomes
